address: 258-260 Chillingham Road, Heaton, Newcastle Upon Tyne, NE6 5LQ, United Kingdom
bio: Set up by a group of friends, the nest theme comes courtesy of tree trunks lining the wall and branches on the ceiling. The interesting set menus offer simple dishes not constricted by culinary boundaries; they are carefully cooked, fresh and well flavoured, and there's a fun element to them that actually works quite well. It’s a relaxed place where you’ll be well looked after....
